final_assessment: All ten resolved by repairs inside the change: the account is now written when apply is complete (the apply gate passing) rather than by the session that checks the last task, the apply rows split cleanly with a reopened change replacing its account once (the user ratified A), the account folder carries the decisions folder identity check, the walk body carries its own field list, and named limits cover the unread prose and two writers.
